title: Saratchandra Goswami Rachanavali (শৰৎচন্দ্ৰ গোস্বামী ৰচনাৱলী)
author: Saratchandra Goswami (Ed. Jatindranath Goswami)
description: Comprehensive collected works of Saratchandra Goswami, the founding secretary of the Asam Sahitya Sabha. It contains his pioneering field explorations of Upper Assam folktales, oral traditions, and the historical documentation of the Khamyang, Phake, and Moran ethnic groups in Lakhimpur and Dibrugarh districts.
source: Guwahati: Publication Board Assam, Archive ID: in.ernet.dli.2015.451226
